description: This file defines the OrleansJsonSerializationBinder class, which implements custom type binding logic for JSON serialization using Orleans serialization framework. It resolves types based on a provided TypeResolver.

classes.name: OrleansJsonSerializationBinder
classes.description: A custom serialization binder that resolves types during JSON deserialization using a TypeResolver.

methods.name: OrleansJsonSerializationBinder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the binder with a TypeResolver.

methods.name: BindToType
methods.description: Overrides the method to resolve a type given its assembly and type name, using the TypeResolver.
